testpaths = tests"' with 'printf '[pytest]
testpaths = tests
'' which reliably produces proper newline-separated output across all POSIX shells. All other Dockerfile commands executed successfully in the build, and the fix preserves the exact same pytest.ini content that was verified in the agent trajectory.
